note: [M] writes the telescope identity as a displayed formula; Lean carries it as `taxi_formula`/`change_one` (rest of the word kept as a scalar factor) and `Agrees.then`.

lemma change_one {i:Fin n}(P P':Fin n→Menu S L)(h_eq: rest P i = rest P' i)(hg:Regular l T (fork n f) a ν z)(hb:((fork n f).topAge a ν) ≤ b)(hT:Tendsto T l atTop)(h:∀ j,Eligible l T (down j z) b (P j))(h':∀ j,Eligible l T (down j z) b (P' j))
      (h_use:∀ (q:(Menu.rest P i).Draw),∃ ζ:ℝ, RateLE l T ((rest P i).pick q).amp ζ ∧ Agrees U l T (down i z) ((fork n f).topAge a ν) b (W+ ((rest P i).pick q).cost) (r-ζ) (P i) (P' i)):
       Agrees U l T z ((fork n f).topAge a ν) b W r (fuse P) (fuse P') :=by

proof_context.conclusion: Replacing one child's menu by another changes the fused menu by the child difference times the fixed remaining product, so successive replacements compose.

snippet.text: lemma Agrees.then (hT:Tendsto T l atTop)(h:Agrees U l T o u b W r A B')(h':Agrees U l T o u b W r B' D):Agrees U l T o u b W r A D :=fun w y z p q he=> ((h w y z p q he).add (h' w y z p q he) hT).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun _=> sub_add_sub_cancel ..)

proof_context.conclusion: Agreement is transitive, via the telescoping identity `(A-B')+(B'-D)=A-D`.
